17-13-0303-C(1) Type 1 Narrative & Plans ~ 2029 West 17" Street, Chicago, IL

Proposed Zoning: RM-4.5 Residential Multi-Unit District
Lot Area: Approx. 2,995.2 sq. ft.

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant is proposing to develop the subject property with a three and
a half-story residential building containing three (3) dwelling units. The
proposed building will measure 39 ft.-7.63 in. in height. The subject
property is a Transit Served Location and will be supported by three (3) off-
street parking spaces at the rear. Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-0303-D optional
Administrative Adjustment and Variation and pursuant to Sec. 17-13-1003-
EE of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, the Applicant is seeking to increase
the off-street parking ratio from 66.66% (2 parking spaces) to 100% (3
parking spaces) and is seeking all zoning relief, as needed and as allowed
by the Chicago Zoning Code, for the attached plans.

(A) The Project’s Floor Area Ratio: 4,233 square feet (1.41 FAR)

(B) The Project’s Density (Minimum Lot Area Per D.U.): 998.4 square feet per D.U.
G3 residential units)

(C) The amount of off-street parking: 3 parking spaces

*The subject property is a designated Transit Served Location (West 18"" Street
CTA Pink line rail station). Pursuant to Sec, 17-13-1003-EE, the Applicant is
seeking to increase the off-street parking ratio from 66.66% (2 parking spaces) to
100% (3 parking spaces).

(D) Setbacks:
a. Front Setback: 14.92 ft. (proposed)
b. Side Setbacks:
East Side: 2.8 ft. (proposed)
West Side: 2 ft. (proposed)
c. Rear Setback: 34.94 ft. (proposed)

(E) Building Height: 39 ft.-7.63 in.
